calls.reason: The packet contains no market outcome evidence. It cannot establish AI-spending punishment or its severity relative to NVIDIA by Q1 2025.

LLMindset measured 14-second average thinking time on one task, and OpenAI reported remaining factual errors. These support parts of the statement, but the judgment about exciting features is subjective.

Crunchbase reports substantial August AI funding, and Glean announced September expansion. Neither establishes sector-wide conditions, and the packet does not link the named events to an emerging collapse.
ITPro documents a broad stock selloff and Reuters reports financing stress. Neither establishes that generative AI has failed commercially or that such failure caused downstream business losses.

AWS reports widespread adoption, but price instability is unestablished. FutureSearch estimates positive API gross margins while acknowledging that its figures remain unverified and exclude major costs.

NIST supports the concern about consequential use, but the mathematical papers establish only qualified limits. Neither those papers nor OpenAI's abstention argument settles whether elimination requires new mathematics.
